long_biography.plain_text:
Chartworld Group places Lou Kollakis at the head of a family enterprise whose maritime roots reach back to nineteenth-century Oinousses. He assumed commercial responsibility within the inherited business and later became chairman, working alongside successive family generations while broadening the group's international shipping and management activities.

His public contribution developed in parallel through the British School at Athens. Kollakis financed the Anastasia Kollakis Wing of its library and established the Eleftherios Art Studio. He also helped launch a development programme, while the School credits his family with supporting its librarian post for 2024–26. Together, these roles reflect an operating career combined with sustained cultural philanthropy rather than a purely passive inheritance.
